item.text: {"hypothesis_status":"not_supported","summary":"L010 executed successfully and passed the fixed G01 positive-Tc guard (8.6690 K <= 8.8322 K), but it did not improve the A05 incumbent. Pooled weighted OOF MAE was 7.7930 K versus 7.7526 K, a deterioration of 0.0404 K rather than the required gain of at least 0.01 K. Relative to A05, reported-zero MAE improved from 6.0806 K to 5.8465 K, but positive-Tc MAE worsened from 8.5051 K to 8.6690 K and high-Tc MAE worsened from 28.8502 K to 29.0322 K. Thus extra_trees/log1p specialization of fe_anion creates a zero-versus-positive tradeoff, not an eligible pooled win. The persistent dominant errors remain in cu_o, where reported-zero materials are severely overpredicted and high-Tc materials are severely underpredicted.","next_action":"continue","next_focus":"Because the required successful-unique-cycle minimum remains pending, test the remaining untried fe_anion estimator-target combination around A05: composition input, chemistry routing, global extra_trees/raw, cu_o extra_trees/raw, other extra_trees/raw, and fe_anion hist_gradient_boosting/log1p. Raw-target fe_anion experts failed with both estimators, while L010 shows that log1p with extra_trees improves reported-zero error but loses more on positive and high-Tc cases. This focused experiment tests whether hist_gradient_boosting can moderate that target-compression tradeoff without changing A05's cu_o or other predictions. It is falsified as an eligible improvement unless pooled weighted OOF MAE is below 7.742598770753422 K and positive-Tc MAE remains at or below 8.832165507919859 K.","stop_reason":"","limitations":["All measurements are adaptive development evidence from reused fixed-group training OOF folds, not independent validation or proof of generalization.","L010 passed the deterministic positive-Tc guard but missed the incumbent by 0.0404 K and did not meet the required 0.01 K gain.","Chemistry routes are operational composition partitions rather than verified physical material families.","The fe_anion route has only 285 rows and 37 groups; its high-Tc subgroup has only 43 rows across 6 groups.","The cu_o route continues to exhibit severe zero-versus-high-Tc ambiguity, and no result identifies new superconductors."]}
